models.name: Qwen4-Max
models._note: Launch blog 'Qwen4-Max: Your New Teammate Has Arrived' dated 2026/11/16; AA releaseDate 2026-11-16 (Vals lists Nov 15, US time). First Qwen4-architecture model: GDN + Qwen Sparse Attention, Gated Residual, N-gram Embedding; 2.4T backbone, 71B active per token, +328B N-gram Embedding parameters; native vision; 1M context. OpenRouter (Alibaba provider): max output 393,216 tokens, reasoning efforts low/high/xhigh (default high) or off, $1.50/$4.50 per M, cache read $0.075, cache write $1.875 (5 min) / $3.00 (1 h). Base id = xhigh (blog charts, Vals and ALE Codex runs are xhigh; AA Terminal-Bench 4.0 48.48 equals the xhigh value).
